objective: Change the existing zero-sale asset from a paid-file-only listing into a free playable demo plus a self-service high-value commercial-license tier without requiring owner delivery work.

target_scope.countable: Verified revenue that continues without the owner's ongoing work or service delivery.
excluded: owner-delivered consulting, customization, installation, support, or client services

baseline.largest_uncertainty: Qualified buyer traffic and price acceptance; two views are insufficient to estimate conversion.

option_decision.reason: The account and public product already exist; itch officially supports a free demo file and individually priced files on one page. This changes acquisition, price model, and buyer segment while keeping delivery automatic and external cost at zero.

rejected_for_now.reason: No verified sales movement; the same offer layer must not be polished again.
The marketplace shows current demand, but new-author intake is paused and therefore cannot shorten time to cash now.

playable_demo_zip.name: Brandable_Idle_Clicker_Playable_Demo_v1.zip
features: purchase CTA after an in-product milestone

tests.jsdom_browser_flow: passed: mobile markup, purchase, automatic income, CTA, zero runtime errors

offer.extended_license_delivery: Automatic certificate file plus access to the existing source kit; no consulting, customization, installation, or support included.
offer.fee_note: Gross and fee scenarios are planning inputs only. No predicted sale is counted as realized or contracted revenue.

forecast.method: Decision scenarios from a zero-revenue baseline, not calibrated statistical confidence intervals.
forecast.maintenance_definition: At least two measurements 30 or more days apart at or above JPY 200,000 verified non-labor income, plus evidence for the following 30 days.
forecast.p20_path: The demo and Extended tier go live promptly, indexed traffic becomes qualified, and five Extended licenses clear within one rolling 30-day window.
forecast.p50_path: Two measured customer/channel/offer rotations are required before a repeatable five-sale monthly mix is found.
forecast.p80_path: The single-product route remains weak and a broader license catalog, affiliate distribution, or recurring bundle is required.
forecast.largest_uncertainty: Traffic quality, high-ticket price acceptance, platform fees, refunds, FX, and time to first five sales.

measurement_contract.baseline: itch: 2 views, 0 downloads, 0 purchases; Gumroad: 0 sales
measurement_contract.success_condition: Logged-out read-back shows a free playable demo, the existing US$25 source offer, and an individually priced US$349 Extended license; then at least one verified Extended sale establishes price acceptance.
measurement_contract.effect_window: Measure for 14 days after publication and until at least 100 product views, whichever is later.
measurement_contract.withdrawal_condition: If the effect window closes with zero purchases and no checkout signal, stop same-page micro-edits and change customer/channel/offer layer.
measurement_contract.target_condition: Five verified Extended sales in a rolling 30-day period, with actual platform net converted to JPY and no owner service work.

external_mutation.reason: Uploading and pricing files on the authenticated seller page, and final publication intent, require the owner session.

user_gate.completion_signal: Return only the public itch product URL after logged-out verification; do not send credentials or codes.
